title: University Course Enrollment Growth
scenario: For every course, compute the year-over-year percentage growth in enrollment.
tableSchema: enrollments (course_id INT, yr INT, student_count INT)
hint: Use LAG to find previous year's student count.
correctQuery: SELECT course_id, yr, (student_count - prev_count)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(prev_count, 0) AS growth_rate FROM (SELECT course_id, yr, student_count, LAG(student_count) OVER(PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY yr) AS prev_count FROM enrollments) t;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE enrollments (course_id INT, yr INT, student_count INT);
